svg.title: Azhora — a traveler’s chart drawn from the developed World Builder map
svg.desc: Authored terrain, region boundaries, names, and rivers exported from azhora.wwmap and drawn as an inked parchment chart. 18700 hexes, 131 regions, 572 river edges. The photographic sketch underlay is excluded. Uncharted: Cape Thalmagar.
